text:
alex: Heads-up — payments sent an alert: sudden cluster of chargebacks on acct `acct_8kPq` starting 03/04 02:10 UTC. ~17 reversals in ~2hrs, high geo velocity (VN, TH, PH). Can ops/risk triage?

samir: yikes. any overlap in BINs or identical last4?

alex: quick dump from PSP attached in thread (csv). sample lines: `tx_987, acct_8kPq, $12.00, VN, bin: 457173, last4: 4242, ip: 103.23.12.5, auth_device: android`

lia: pinging @fraud-bot to get existing flags + chargeback codes. also cc @ops-oncall for potential temporary hold. :eyes:

fraud-bot: auto-report: 17 CHARGEBACKS (R07/R10 mix), 12 unique cards, repeated IP prefix 103.23. Active rules triggered: GEO_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD, MULTI_DECLINE_CHAIN.

samir: thanks. lia — can we get AVS mismatch rate and BIN issuer country? if a lot are VN BINs maybe a compromised BIN set.

lia: grabbing AVS/msisdn now. quick note: 5 of the disputes list `merchant descriptor` = "PocketPro Sub" — looks like subscription product. Could be trial abuse then disputed.

alex: interesting — product team, are there overlapping promo codes or a free trial that could explain chargeback incentive? @ops-oncall can we pause new subs for acct_8kPq until triage?

ops-oncall: can do a soft block (stop new checkout flows) in 10m. STM: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/blocks -d '{"account":"acct_8kPq","reason":"suspected-fraud-geo-velocity"}'` (will log).

samir: put hold. also we need to prepare dispute evidence packet for each cb: capture IP, user-agent, AVS, 3DS status, full refund history. ops — can you export the last 90 days of invoices for acct_8kPq?

ops-oncall: exporting now. ETA 8m.

lia: fraud-bot shows 9 of the 17 had `3DS = false`. That's a red flag. I'll flag subscription flow for immediate 3DS enforcement for that merchant id.

alex: good. Samir — for evidence we should include sample successful auth logs and any signed T&C or subscription screenshots. Also need last 4 of card + BIN ranges in the packet.

samir: running quick SQL to pull tx ids: `SELECT id, created_at, ip, ua, auth_code, three_ds FROM transactions WHERE account='acct_8kPq' AND created_at > '2026-03-04' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200;`

lia: note for disputes team: PSP is asking for proof of service for all 17 disputes within 10 business days. if we miss deadline we auto-lose.

alex: assign owner for compiling dispute evidence. lia do you own?

lia: I can own assembly of the packet but need full CSV from ops + screenshots from product.

ops-oncall: CSV export ready: s3://redwood-ops-exports/exports/1827001234-acct_8kPq-tx.csv (shared with finance).

samir: grabbing it now. i'll pull BIN summary and attach a short risk memo.

alex: also escalate to payment provider rep — ask for chargeback reason codes detail and if they can fast-track pre-arbitration. @lia can you message the PSP rep?

lia: on it. message sent: "We have a cluster of chargebacks on acct_8kPq, potentially coordinated. Need reason code breakouts, whether issuer has requested retrievals pre-chargeback, and whether presigned evidence upload endpoints exist."

fraud-bot: update: two new alerts in the same thread window for `acct_2Xz` (different acct) — looks like account switching attack pattern across multiple merchants. pattern id: 2026-03-GEO-VEL-02.

samir: hmm if it's cross-account, could be larger botnet. I'll add BIN entropy check + look for duplicate device fingerprints across accounts.

alex: priority: 1) soft block new subs on acct_8kPq (done), 2) compile evidence packet for PSP within 10 biz days, 3) enforce 3DS on subscription flow, 4) inform sales if merchant is enterprise so they can prep customer comms.

lia: PSP rep replied: "We see chargebacks initiated by issuers in US/UK for some cards; we'll extend 3 extra days for evidence upload due to volume." small win.

ops-oncall: exported invoices & tx logs to S3 in two files: invoices.csv and transactions.csv. shared with @samir and @lia.

samir: prepping memo: summarizing 17 CBs, 12 unique cards, 9 no-3DS, repeated IP prefix, BIN cluster around 4571xx, subscription descriptor matches. recommend dispute responses with auth + UA + TOS screenshots. Will attach SQL and analytics snippet.

alex: please drop the dispute packet link here once done and set a reminder to follow up with PSP in 48hrs.

lia: will update thread when packet uploaded. dropping checklist: [x] soft block, [x] exports, [x] PSP leniency, [ ] evidence packet assembled, [ ] follow-up with sales/comms.

samir: uploaded memo + evidence CSV summary to s3://redwood-finance/disputes/1827001234-evidence-packet.zip

alex: perfect. closing the loop — keep this thread active until final outcome. thanks all :pray:
